parameters.label: Event Label Settings
parameters.description: Choose settings regarding the Event Labels.

fields.label: Sprite Based?
fields.description: True uses a sprite label that scales with the map, supports hue cycling and follows an attached picture height. False uses a window label that compensates for screen zoom and centers multiline text. Both implementations are available.
fields.scopeLimit: true draws a sprite scaled by FontSize/mainFontSize; false uses a transparent text window and compensates map zoom. Both follow the event and share range visibility. IconSize and LineHeight configure the window mode; sprite mode uses native text measurement. Create content with <Label: Shop> in an event Note or page Comment.

fields.label: Mobile-Enabled?
fields.description: Enable event labels for mobile devices?

fields.label: Font Size
fields.description: Label font size in pixels. Sprite mode scales text relative to the game main font; window mode sets its drawing font size.
fields.scopeLimit: Measured in pixels. FontSize scales sprite labels and sets window text size; IconSize affects drawn icons in window labels.

fields.label: Icon Size
fields.description: Icon dimensions in pixels for window-based labels. Sprite-based labels render normal text escapes and scale them with FontSize; this field does not set their icon size.
fields.scopeLimit: Measured in pixels. FontSize scales sprite labels and sets window text size; IconSize affects drawn icons in window labels.

fields.label: Line Height
fields.description: Minimum line/window height in pixels for window-based labels. Sprite-based labels measure text instead.
fields.scopeLimit: Measured in pixels. LineHeight sets window-mode line height; the whole Label default supplies 30, while this field default 26 is used only when the field is absent.

fields.label: Offset X
fields.description: Default horizontal label offset in pixels from the event screen center; negative moves left and positive right. Event Note then active-page label offsets override it.
fields.scopeLimit: Pixel offset from the centered label above the event graphic. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down. Set 0 for no additional displacement. Label content comes from event Note/page Comment <Label: Shop>.

fields.label: Offset Y
fields.description: Default vertical label offset in pixels from above the character (or attached picture in sprite mode), including window padding. Positive moves down, negative up. Event Note then active-page offsets override it.
fields.scopeLimit: Pixel offset from the centered label above the event graphic. Positive X moves right; positive Y moves down. Set 0 for no additional displacement. Label content comes from event Note/page Comment <Label: Shop>.

fields.label: Fade Speed
fields.description: Opacity change per game update for label fade in/out on the 0–255 scale. A positive value fades toward visibility; 0 freezes the current opacity. Encounter transitions still hide it immediately.
fields.scopeLimit: Opacity units per rendered update on the 0–255 scale, applied toward visible/hidden according to label range. The editor minimum is 1; 10 needs up to 26 updates for a full fade. Use a value of at least 1.

fields.label: Visible Range
fields.description: Default player-to-event visibility distance in map tiles, using RangeType. 0 shows only a matching position; per-event Label Range tags override this default.
fields.scopeLimit: Create a label with <Label: Shop> in an event Note or page Comment; label tags can override per-event range and offsets. Distances are map tiles and range boundaries are inclusive; square uses max axis distance, circle rounded Euclidean distance, radius/delta/diamond Manhattan distance, row vertical distance and column horizontal distance. Font/icon size, line height and offsets are pixels. OpacitySpeed changes opacity on the 0–255 scale per rendered update; positive 10 takes up to 26 updates for a full fade. The Label container default sets LineHeight to 30; the field default 26 is the fallback for a missing field, not an override of the container value.

fields.label: Range Type
fields.description: Default distance shape: square compares each axis separately; circle compares rounded Euclidean distance; radius/delta/diamond compare map Manhattan distance. Row/column, when authored as custom strings, limit only vertical/horizontal distance. Unknown strings never pass the range check.

fields.label: JS: Pre-Copy
fields.description: JavaScript run before copy operations using this named template. See scopeLimit for hook arguments and execution order.
fields.scopeLimit: JavaScript function body executed by the game for copy; return value is ignored. this and arguments[2] are the receiving Game_Event; arguments[0] is the source map ID and arguments[1] the source event ID. Global hooks apply to all operations; per-template hooks apply only to named templates. Order: global pre, named pre, copy/refresh, global post, named post. Pre runs before applying the operation; Post sees the refreshed event. Spawn Pre sees the constructed source event before dynamic identity and position are applied; Spawn Post sees the new dynamic event. Restoring a preserved morph does not run morph hooks. The serialized default contains illustrative declarations with shifted argument indices; use the actual contract above when writing code, for example const target = this; const sourceMapId = arguments[0];. The CLI validates syntax without executing the code.
fields.context: Empty body performs no additional action; runtime exceptions propagate. Reset restores the published native body, including its historical illustrative declarations.

parameters.label: Movement Settings
parameters.description: Change the rules regarding movement in the game.

fields.label: 8 Directional Movement
fields.description: Editor heading 8 Directional Movement; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Enable
fields.description: Allow 8-directional movement by default? Players can move diagonally.

fields.label: Strict Collision
fields.description: Enforce strict collission rules where the player must be able to pass both cardinal directions?

fields.label: Favor Horizontal
fields.description: Favor horizontal if cannot pass diagonally but can pass both horizontally and vertically?

fields.label: Slower Diagonals?
fields.description: Enforce a slower movement speed when moving diagonally?

fields.label: Speed Multiplier
fields.description: What's the multiplier to adjust movement speed when moving diagonally?
fields.scopeLimit: Only applied when SlowerSpeed is true and the last movement direction is diagonal. Multiplies the move-speed exponent after adding DashModifier, not the tile distance. 0 uses 0.01 at runtime. No additional clamp; use a positive finite multiplier, for example 0.85.

fields.label: Automatic Movement
fields.description: Editor heading Automatic Movement; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Stop During Events
fields.description: Stop automatic event movement while events are running.

fields.label: Stop During Messages
fields.description: Stop automatic event movement while a message is running.

fields.label: Bitmap
fields.description: Editor heading Bitmap; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Smoothing
fields.description: Do you want to smooth or pixelate the map sprites? Pixelating them is better for zooming and tilting.

fields.label: Dash
fields.description: Editor heading Dash; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Dash Modifier
fields.description: Alters the dash speed modifier.
fields.scopeLimit: Added to the native move-speed exponent while dashing, not multiplied into distance. MZ distance per frame = 2^realMoveSpeed / 256 tiles, so +1 doubles distance. Numeric values are not clamped by this setting; use finite values appropriate to the map.

fields.label: Dash On Ladder?
fields.description: Allow dashing while on a ladder or rope?

fields.label: Enable Dash Tilt?
fields.description: Allow tilt while a character is dashing and moving. Ladder use, an active pose, an overhead icon or a Dragonbones sprite suppresses tilt.

fields.label: Tilt Left Amount
fields.description: Rotation in radians for eligible dash movement left, upper-left or lower-left. Positive rotates clockwise; negative counterclockwise. Requires EnableDashTilt.

fields.label: Tilt Right Amount
fields.description: Rotation in radians for eligible dash movement right, upper-right or lower-right. Positive rotates clockwise; negative counterclockwise. Requires EnableDashTilt.

fields.label: Tilt Vertical Amount
fields.description: Tilt amplitude in radians for eligible vertical dashing: animation patterns 0/1/2 use negative/zero/positive amplitude. Requires EnableDashTilt.

fields.label: Event Movement
fields.description: Editor heading Event Movement; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Random Move Weight
fields.description: Use numbers between 0 and 1. Numbers closer to 1 stay closer to their home position. 0 to disable it.

fields.label: Shift Y
fields.description: How many pixels should non-tile characters be shifted by? Negative: up. Positive: down.

fields.label: Path Finding
fields.description: Editor heading Path Finding; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Mobile-Enabled?
fields.description: Allow diagonal movement support on mobile devices. False disables diagonal support there before map tags and player overrides are considered; true allows the ordinary diagonal rules. It does not force diagonal pathfinding for a held touch.

fields.label: Shadows
fields.description: Editor heading Shadows; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Show
fields.description: Create shadow sprites for eligible map characters. False prevents their creation, so ShadowShow commands cannot restore them. Tile/object/empty/transparent characters and vehicles do not display these shadows.

fields.label: Default Filename
fields.description: Exact case-sensitive shadow image filename without extension from img/system, for example Shadow1. Prepare that image in the game. Per-event Shadow Filename tags can replace it.

fields.label: Shadow Z Layer
fields.description: What is the sprite Z layer used for the shadow sprites?
fields.scopeLimit: Tilemap child z value for the shadow. Native character priority layers are 1 (below), 3 (normal) and 5 (above); tiles also occupy tilemap layers. Default 0.5 places shadows behind normal characters. The setting is not clamped. An event Custom Z below zero overrides its shadow to z-1; other Custom Z values reset the shadow to 0.

fields.label: Turn in Place
fields.description: Editor heading Turn in Place; no independent runtime action. Preserve its published native value when writing the containing object.
fields.writing: Read-only editorial entry. Configure the operational fields in the containing object or command; do not write this heading directly.

fields.label: Enable
fields.description: When not dashing, player will turn in place before moving. This only applies with keyboard inputs.

fields.label: Delay in Frames
fields.description: Input-update count before the player moves while EnableTurnInPlace is true. At60 updates/second, 10 is about 1/6 second. Only stationary, non-dashing, non-ladder movement without a touch destination turns first; 0 removes the delay.

fields.label: Vehicle Speeds

fields.label: Boat Speed
fields.description: Allows you to adjust the base speed of the boat vehicle.
fields.scopeLimit: Native MZ move-speed exponent, set when the vehicle initializes. Distance per frame = 2^speed / 256 tiles; 4 gives 1/16 tile per frame. 0 leaves the native vehicle speed unchanged. The field is not clamped; use a finite value. It does not multiply another speed.

fields.label: Airship Speed

fields.scopeLimit: Native MZ move-speed exponent, set when the vehicle initializes. Distance per frame = 2^speed / 256 tiles; 4 gives 1/16 tile per frame. 0 leaves the native vehicle speed unchanged. The field is not clamped; use a finite value. It does not multiply another speed.

parameters.scopeLimit: Movement values are plugin defaults; map tags and commands may override the selected behavior. MZ move speed is an exponent: distance per frame = 2^realMoveSpeed / 256 tiles. Use the individual field descriptors for conditions and limits.

fields.label: Auto-Balloon Poses
fields.description: Automatically pose VS8 sprites when using balloon icons.
fields.scopeLimit: Use a character image named with [VS8] in img/characters, laid out as 12 columns by 8 rows (eight 3x4 character blocks); do not combine with the $ single-character prefix. Blocks 0/1 walk cardinal/diagonal, 2/3 dash, 4/5 carry, 6 ladder/rope and poses, 7 expression poses. Pose tags/routes require matching art; no missing pose is generated. Balloon IDs 1–10 select exclamation, question, music note, heart, anger, sweat, cobweb, silence, light bulb, sleep. In block 7 the first two rows contain exclamation/question/music and heart/anger/sweat; row 3 contains cobweb/silence/light bulb, row 4 sleep. Block 6 rows 3/4 contain item/hmph/victory and hurt/kneel/collapse. Columns within a pose row are patterns 0/1/2.

fields.label: Balloon Offset X
fields.description: Horizontal balloon offset in pixels for [VS8] characters, relative to the native balloon position. Positive moves right, negative left.

fields.label: Balloon Offset Y
fields.description: Offset balloon icons on VS8 sprites by y pixels.
fields.scopeLimit: Vertical balloon displacement in pixels; positive moves down, negative up. The VS8 container default supplies 12, whereas the field fallback is 10 when absent. It applies only to VS8 balloon presentation.

parameters.label: Common Event on OK Button
parameters.description: Assign Common Events to Region IDs for the OK action. RegionOkTarget selects the player tile or the tile in front; its default is front.

fields.label: Region 1
fields.description: Which Common Event does this region activate? Use 0 to not activate any Common Events.
fields.scopeLimit: Paint the numbered Region ID on map tiles in the MZ region layer. The value is a Common Event ID from the game database; 0 disables this region. Use an existing positive ID; this field does not create an event. RegionOk runs on the OK action at the standing tile or front tile selected by RegionOkTarget. RegionTouch runs when the player triggers touch at their tile. A running/starting map event or busy message prevents reservation, and normal map events have priority. Configure the two usages separately; the same Common Event may be assigned to both. These mappings apply to every map, not to a single event page.

commands.label: Auto Movement: Events
commands.description: Set the saved global permission for ordinary autonomous event movement: Allow enables it, Stop disables it and Toggle inverts it. Forced routes and movement synchronization have their own execution paths.
commands.context: Game_System retains this flag across maps and save/load; a new game defaults to Allow. Allow still respects StopAutoMoveEvents, StopAutoMoveMessages and inactive-scene gates. Authoring the command does not execute it.

args.label: Value
args.description: Allow events to move automatically?

Forced routes and movement synchronization have their own execution paths. Game_System retains this flag across maps and save/load; a new game defaults to Allow. Allow still respects StopAutoMoveEvents, StopAutoMoveMessages and inactive-scene gates.

commands.label: Call Event: Remote Read
commands.description: Load a native map file and run the selected one-based event page as a child of the calling interpreter. The called list uses the caller event ID rather than the source event ID.
commands.context: Waits for the map file before starting the child. Reads the saved map file, not a live morphed/spawned event. Page conditions are not used to select the explicit page; an absent event/page runs no child. A map transfer clears pending calls owned by the outgoing map. Authoring the command does not execute it.

The CLI checks syntax without executing it; runtime expression errors propagate. Waits for the map file before starting the child. Reads the saved map file, not a live morphed/spawned event. args.label: Template Name
args.description: Name of the target event template to morph into. Ignored if this is called "Untitled".
args.scopeLimit: Create named entries in Template.List with Name, MapID and EventID of an existing source event. Maps in PreloadMaps and every named entry MapID load at boot, before the title; missing files are resource errors. Use <Copy Event: Guard> in an event Note or choose TemplateName Guard in MorphEventTo/SpawnEventAt. Names are trimmed and case-insensitive; if duplicates exist the last entry wins. Use unique names. UNTITLED selects explicit source map/event IDs in commands. Morph changes the target event data/pages/graphic without executing its command list and keeps the target map/event identity. Step1MapId/Step1EventId select the target; Step2MapId/Step2EventId select the source only when TemplateName is UNTITLED. Zero maps mean current map; zero event IDs mean the caller. With Preserve false only a current-map target is changed and it resets on map reconstruction. Preserve true records the morph for later map visits and save/load; a remote-map target is applied when that map is loaded. An absent named template performs no immediate morph. Remove restores the underlying copy/original data on the current map; RemovePreserve false leaves the stored morph, so it returns at the next reconstruction, while true removes that record.

commands.label: Player Icon: Change
commands.description: Set the player overhead icon, offsets and blend mode.
commands.context: Stored in Game_System across maps and save/load until PlayerIconDelete or a replacement. A positive IconSet index displays it; VS8 auto buffering can replace manual offsets. Authoring the command does not execute it.

args.label: Icon Index
args.description: Icon index used for the icon. You may use JavaScript code.
args.scopeLimit: MapId 0 selects the current map and EventId 0 the map-event caller; otherwise supply existing numeric IDs. Temporary EventIconChange is reset on page setup; Forced survives that reset until changed or restored. Delete stores a hidden override that survives page setup. Restore removes the override and reapplies current page/Note icon settings, or no icon if none is authored; it is not an undo stack. State is keyed by map/event and saved with the game. Icons use the zero-based img/system/IconSet.png grid; choose an existing positive icon index, while 0 is invisible. Buffers are pixels: X positive right from center, Y positive down from the top of the character; VS8 AutoBuffer overrides them.

commands.context: Runs against the current map. Source maps other than the current map must already be preloaded through EV-S-Template-PreloadMaps or the named EV-S-Template-List entry. args.scopeLimit: Create named entries in Template.List with Name, MapID and EventID of an existing source event. UNTITLED selects explicit source map/event IDs in commands. TemplateName other than UNTITLED overrides source MapId/EventId; leave MapId 0 when using a named template. Explicit MapId 0 means current map, EventId 0 the map-event caller. A remote explicit MapId must already be preloaded even before named resolution. No eligible position or absent template creates nothing. Region/terrain selection chooses randomly among eligible tiles on the current map. Preserve false removes the spawn when leaving for a different map; saving on the same map still serializes the current instance. Preserve true retains it across transfer and save/load until despawn. ID allocation starts at 1000; retired IDs are not reused within the map spawn list. New Game resets these instances.

tags.label: Diagonal Movement
tags.description: Map diagonal default, overridden by the player diagonal command.
examples: events-move tags set --project "<game>" --target map:1 --tag diagonal-movement --value '"<Diagonal Movement: Off>"' --expected-hash "<fileHash from list>" --dry-run --json
tags.context: Targets: map. On enables and Off disables map diagonal support while PlayerDiagonalSetting is default; the enable/disable command overrides the map tag. On wins if both map tags occur. Without either tag use Movement.EnableDir8. Mobile with Movement.PathfindMobileEnabled=false disables diagonal support before these overrides. This does not provide eight-direction sprite artwork. Native file edits take effect after the game reloads the affected data; CLI authoring never executes the tag effect. Examples are illustrative: substitute existing game/map/event/page IDs, an existing Comment index when used, and required assets/state.

Choose --occurrence N for a zero-based duplicate. Removal edits the native field, not already-created runtime state.
dependencies: RPG Maker MZ 1.10.0; enable Coreto_0_CoreEngine 0.1.0 before Coreto_1_EventsMoveCore 0.1.0 and disable VisuMZ_1_EventsMoveCore.

tags.context: Targets: event-note, event-comment. Event Note is read before active-page Comments; settings are rebuilt at page setup. tags.description: Multiply distance from the event home by this weight to select the return-home branch.
examples: events-move tags set --project "<game>" --target map:1/event:1 --tag random-move-weight --value '"<Random Move Weight: 0.1>"' --expected-hash "<fileHash from list>" --dry-run --json
tags.context: Targets: event-note, event-comment. Event Note is read before active-page Comments; settings are rebuilt at page setup. Read event Note first, then page comment lines in list order; later assignments win. True Random Move wins within the same line. Applies only to native Random autonomous movement; home bias is distance * weight, with distance in map tiles. The published scopeLimit defines zero/negative and product>=1 behavior. No rounding is applied to the signed decimal factor. Native file edits take effect after the game reloads the affected data; CLI authoring never executes the tag effect. Examples are illustrative: substitute existing game/map/event/page IDs, an existing Comment index when used, and required assets/state.

Choose --occurrence N for a zero-based duplicate. Removal edits the native field, not already-created runtime state.
tags.scopeLimit: For native random autonomous movement, compare a random number in [0,1) with Manhattan distance from home multiplied by weight. If the random number is below the product, move toward home; otherwise use native random movement. 0 or a negative weight disables the home bias; a product at least 1 always tries home. Choose 0–1 for ordinary use.
dependencies: RPG Maker MZ 1.10.0; enable Coreto_0_CoreEngine 0.1.0 before Coreto_1_EventsMoveCore 0.1.0 and disable VisuMZ_1_EventsMoveCore.

tags.label: Move Synch Target
tags.description: Move when the selected player or event takes a step.
examples: events-move tags set --project "<game>" --target map:1/event:1 --tag move-synch-target --value '"<Move Synch Target: Player>"' --expected-hash "<fileHash from list>" --dry-run --json
tags.context: Targets: event-note, event-comment. Event Note is read before active-page Comments; settings are rebuilt at page setup. Player selects target 0; Event N selects that event database/runtime ID on the current map (Event 0 also resolves to the player). No target tag restores ordinary autonomous movement. A configured target suppresses ordinary autonomous stepping; a missing event does not step. methods.label: Independent movement route instructions

methods.context: Autonomous map event routes and interpreter-owned Set Movement Route (205). The editor Preview does not execute custom grammar; use Playtest.
methods.writing: events-move routes list|insert|update|remove --target map:M/event:E/page:P/route or <event-selector>/command:I/route. Mutations require the current file hash; insertion uses --before, update/remove use --index.
methods.scopeLimit: Use native Move Route Script (code 45). Examples: Move Right: 2; Move Lower Left: 1; Move Right Until Stop; Jump Forward: 2; Move To: 10, 7; Move To Event: 2; Move To Player; Move To Home; Step Toward: 10, 7; Turn To: 10, 7; Teleport To: 10, 7; Self Variable 21: 7; Self Switch A: Toggle; Move Right: \SelfVar[21]; Force Dash: On; Force Carry: Off; Pose: Victory; Pattern Lock: 2; Pattern Unlock; Balloon: Heart. Each is a separate route Script instruction. Configure repeat/skippable/wait natively. VS8 poses require a [VS8] character image. Custom grammar runs in Playtest, not editor route Preview. Movement counts and target coordinates are map tiles; indices and Pattern Lock are zero-based. Fade In/Out takes a positive opacity step per route update on0–255; 0 can keep the instruction repeating indefinitely. Move To repeats until reaching its destination and can stall at an unreachable coordinate. Runtime scripts use the moving Game_Character as this; the CLI authors only supported custom grammar here, not arbitrary JavaScript. Read routes list for the instruction index and file hash.

methods.label: getSelfSwitchValue
methods.description: Reads a switch in explicit map/event scoped storage. See scopeLimit for ID and value types, defaults and runtime context.
methods.context: Runtime game state. Explicit map/event identity; names CLI edits only native System.json names. Values live in Game_SelfSwitches and are serialized with saves; a new game starts empty. Map transfers alone do not clear them. Explicit self-data reset or map-exit cleanup tags can remove scoped data; removing a System name marker does not erase stored keys.
methods.writing: Use authored runtime scripts. For scope/name markers use events-move names get|set --target system:switch:ID or system:variable:ID.
methods.scopeLimit: Use numeric IDs from System.json switches. Letter strings A/B/C/D address native self switches; numeric IDs address numbered Self switches. Map ID is explicit; event ID is explicit and identifies the event on that map. Pass a boolean value; setters coerce with boolean truthiness and request map refresh. Missing reads return false. These global methods run in game Script/plugin code after game objects exist, never through the CLI. They directly address scoped storage and do not require a name marker.

methods.label: Named switch access
methods.description: Case-insensitive ((Name)) or （（Name）） reference. Unknown names warn and read as false. Existing duplicate aliases resolve to the last native ID; the CLI rejects creating duplicates.
methods.context: Runtime value/setValue uses the current event context for Self, current map for Map, and JS expression context for computed reads. Read precedence: JS, Self, Map, native global. CLI names set rejects conflicting scope markers.
methods.writing: events-move names get|set --target system:switch:ID; set requires --expected-hash and a JSON string. JS is compiled without execution offline.
methods.scopeLimit: Name a database switch ((Door)) for a global alias, or <Self> ((Door)) / <Map> ((Door)) for scoped data. In game Script code use $gameSwitches.value("Door") and $gameSwitches.setValue("Door", true). Case and surrounding whitespace are ignored. Self needs a map-event caller; without one it falls back to global storage. Missing aliases read false and writes do nothing with a warning. Duplicate aliases use the last ID; author unique names. Computed names use <JS>expression</JS>: this is the active Game_Event when there is a self target, otherwise the Game_Switches/Game_Variables object; the sole argument is switchId/variableId. The expression return supplies the read (switch coerced to boolean); writes still use ordinary or scoped storage and do not replace the expression. Name indexes and compiled expressions are prepared/cached during the run: restart after authoring System names.

limits: Movement, passage, scoped data, activation, templates, presentation, timers and followers are implemented. Compatible original consumers and versions are listed in compatibleOriginalConsumers; install them after Coreto_1_EventsMoveCore. DragonbonesUnion also requires Public_0_Dragonbones 5.7.002b before it and real skeleton/atlas/texture assets. Message popups require one MessageCore provider and run only on the map; character targets use their tile at creation. Doodads authoring requires its original System/Editor pair in order and an MZ editor Playtest with local filesystem access. Doodad images do not supply collision. Coreto_1_MessageCore and Coreto_1_SaveCore 0.1.0 are supported, including with Coreto BattleCore and OptionsCore.
